text:
dana: Quick design check — dropping the guided-setup mocks here. Inline sample project cards + a compact stepper at top. Primary asks: does the copy feel scannable, CTA contrast safe, and should the checklist be collapsed by default? :thinking_face:

ari: Nice! Copy looks pretty tight but the first paragraph reads long on small screens. Could we try a 1-line intro + a short bulleted hint?

marta: Agree with ari. Also the sample project cards have 12px body text on mobile — that's under our token. Recommend 14px min.

sam: On collapsed checklist: if most users skip it, collapsing reduces noise. But we need a clear affordance to expand (and keyboard focus). Maybe default collapsed for new users who hit quickstart, expanded for the explicit "Start setup" flow.

kevin: CTA color feels low-contrast on the lightbg sample card (btn #5A8FFF on #F6FBFF). I ran a1 contrast check and it's ~3.8:1. We should target 4.5:1 for primary CTAs in this context.

lena-a11y: +1 for contrast. Also keyboard order: the stepper dots are not tabbable currently — users expect arrow + enter to advance. Suggest making the visible control a real button with aria-labels and keeping fancy dots decorative.

marta: Example aria snippet for stepper buttons:
```
<button class="stepper-next" aria-label="Next setup step">Next</button>
<button class="stepper-prev" aria-label="Previous setup step">Back</button>
```
We should also ensure `aria-live` announcement when a new sample project is selected.

dana: Good call. For copy alternatives: option A (short): "Pick a sample project to get a ready-made app with Redwood. Start in minutes." Option B (concise): "Choose a sample to try Redwood with example prompts and config." Thoughts?

ari: Prefer option A. Maybe change "Start in minutes" -> "Get running in minutes" — slightly clearer.

kevin: If we go with option A, we must adjust button label to "Try sample" instead of "Open" so intent matches. Also update analytics event to `onboard.sample_try` when CTA clicked.

lena-a11y: Also recommend adding visible focus ring token on card hover/focus. Current focus is subtle.

sam: UX question: do we show recommended sample (based on detected workload) as primary? I like that but we'd need a fallback if detection uncertain.

dana: Plan: 1) iterate copy to Option A with text tweak from ari; 2) increase card body to 14px; 3) raise CTA color to meet 4.5:1; 4) make stepper controls real buttons w/ aria-labels + aria-live; 5) default checklist collapsed on quickstart path, expanded on explicit setup path; 6) add analytics event `onboard.sample_try`. I'll update the mock and post revised screens by EOD. :white_check_mark:

marta: I'll update the Figma after dana posts. Will also add annotations for keyboard flow.

kevin: I'll propose two accessible color swatches and paste tokens in the thread once available.

lena-a11y: I'll add a short test checklist (contrast, keyboard nav, screenreader path) and attach to the PR template.

ari: Sounds good — thanks everyone. Small follow-up: can we keep CTA size consistent across cards? I noticed one variant had a smaller padding.

dana: Good catch — that'll be in the fix list. Thanks! :clap:
